chatHistory.content:
- 0:00–0:05 — A grid of abstract post tiles (rounded rects, subtle   gradient) fills the frame. A magnifying-glass / scanner glyph      sweeps across them; a faint highlight follows the beam as it        moves.
  - 0:05–0:12 — Scanner stops at center. A small node forms beneath
  it labeled Search. Around the grid, faint floating glyphs start to   emerge in the background: a tiny pin, a tiny profile circle, a
  tiny hashtag — hinting at what's about to surface.
  - 0:12–0:22 — The three floating glyphs gently pulse as the         narrator lists them (people, locations, hashtags, popularity). No
  labels yet — they're just hints, drifting.                          - 0:22–0:30 — Three connection lines spring out from the central
  Search node toward three distinct destinations, staggered ~1s
  apart:                                                                - Places — pin glyph with a small map fragment
    - Profiles — profile circle with a couple of avatar dots            - Hashtags — # glyph with a faint popularity bar underneath
  Each destination scales in after its line completes; small label    below it (Inter, small caps).
  - 0:30–0:32 — All three connected, gentle pulse along the lines     (data flowing outward), hold for the "let me show you how it
  works" line.
  Motion:
  - Scanner beam: smooth horizontal sweep with a soft trailing glow.  - Lines: spring-draw with quick easing.
  - Destination glyphs: spring-in, then breathing/ambient drift.      - Whole composition has gentle drift so it never sits still.
